html:
Wuningangk is the name the map gives to an Aboriginal group of western Arnhem Land in the Northern Territory, in stone country east of Kakadu.

Little is written about them under this name, and it may be a clan or local group of a larger people. Neighbours on the map include the Gunbudj, the Dalabon and the Rembarrnga. The region is famous for its rock art, among the oldest and richest in the world. See Aboriginal Australian societies.
sum: Wuningangk is the name the map gives to an Aboriginal group of western Arnhem Land in the Northern Territory, in stone country east of Kakadu.
